report_name: LOCAL CYCLING AND WALKING INFRASTRUCTURE PLAN Peterlee
how_pct_was_used: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) was used to identify potential demand and forecast the number of journeys to work using corridors in the Government Target Near Market scenario, which informed the prioritisation of key desire lines.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP has informed early design work on active travel schemes in Peterlee to support current funding opportunities, including the identification of priority routes such as the Town Centre to A19, Town Centre to Thorpe Road, and Town Centre to Horden, as well as the Grampian Estate area-based walking priority.
pct_usage_quote: Forecast number of journeys to work using the corridor in the Government Target Near Market scenario (LSOA)
